      "verbatim": "Comparing the results from the systematic reviews of animal studies with the systematic reviews of clinical studies they found that two interventions (bisphosphonates, thrombolytics) were concordant, i.e. the findings from the animal studies agreed with the findings from the human studies, one intervention was partially concordant (antenatal corticosteroids) and three were discordant (corticosteroids, Tirilazad and antifibrinolytics)."

  "headline_index": 0,
  "what_the_study_did": "This study reanalyzed data from a 2007 systematic review to assess the harms to animals and benefits to humans from six pre-clinical animal research interventions, testing the feasibility of a retrospective harm-benefit analysis (HBA).",
  "what_it_found": "The majority of the reviewed animal studies involved severe harms to animals, with many harms not associated with human benefit. Only studies on bisphosphonates appeared to minimize harms while providing human benefits.",
  "key_quotes": [

      "quote": "Comparing the results from the systematic reviews of animal studies with the systematic reviews of clinical studies they found that two interventions (bisphosphonates, thrombolytics) were concordant, i.e. the findings from the animal studies agreed with the findings from the human studies, one intervention was partially concordant (antenatal corticosteroids) and three were discordant (corticosteroids, Tirilazad and antifibrinolytics).",

    },
    {

    },

    },
    {

      "topic": "Citation Scores"
    },
    {
      "quote": "For the studies of corticosteroids and Tirilazad there was high animal suffering and low (no) clinical benefit. Their research importance is considered to be low since the quality of research was poor and their citation scores were below average. As such these studies fall into the solid part of the cube and should not have been approved.",
      "topic": "HBA Assessment"
    },
    {
      "quote": "Only the moderate bisphosphonate studies, less than 7% of the total, appeared to minimise harms to animals whilst being associated with benefit for humans.",

    }
  ]
